comment: Rating points per 1% of each rating stat, the client's gametables/combatratings.txt (the same columns sim/cmd/leveling-bis ratingStatColumns and data/pipeline/simdb/ratings.py divide by). The table is flat from level 1 to the cap in 1.60.1.70755, so one row serves every level.

Every gear score weight is per 1% (stat-weights.json, the engine's sweep, a BiS band's weight_per_percent), while an item's stat line carries rating points (Waywatcher Gauntlets 240081: 20 expertise = 2%). The site (web/src/lib/addon/score.ts), the API (api/internal/sims/gearscore.go) and the addon (Gear.lua via Rules.RATING_PER_PERCENT) divide by these before weighting; each pins its own table to this file.
haste is the addon's: rating haste (ITEM_MOD_HASTE_RATING_SHORT) speeds attacks and casts alike, so it feeds melee_haste and spell_haste, both at this factor.
